items.zh: 插件启停持久化：停用写 enabled=0，重启核心保持停止；开机自启跳过被停用的插件
items.en: Persistent plugin enable/disable: disabling sets enabled=0 and survives core restart; autostart skips disabled plugins

items.zh: 客户端指纹注入：核心按入口协议（Claude Code / Codex）给上游注入客户端指纹头
items.en: Client fingerprint injection: the core injects client fingerprint headers per entry protocol (Claude Code / Codex)

items.zh: 插件安装进度流：市场安装走流式进度（下载/停止/安装/启动），前端实时展示
items.en: Streaming install progress: marketplace install streams phases (download/stop/install/start), shown live in the UI

items.zh: 账号刷新健壮性：静态密钥类插件给友好提示；用户手动改名不再被刷新覆盖
items.en: Refresh robustness: friendly message for static-key plugins; manual display-name edits are no longer overwritten by refresh
